hero_subtext: Founded by a handful of alumni who were tired of watching games alone, the Triangle Gator Club is now the home for Gator Nation in central North Carolina.
contact_text: Questions about membership, sponsorship, or scholarships? Email us, find a board member at a club event or message us on social media!
venue_name_address: RallyPoint Sport Grill · 837 Bass Pro Ln, Cary, NC 27513
story_paragraph_1: It started with six people, one projector and a borrowed back room in downtown Raleigh. Word spread the way it always does in Gator Nation — a chomp across a parking lot, a sticker on a laptop at a coffee shop in Durham — and the room kept getting bigger.
story_paragraph_2: Today we host watch parties for every football game, gather for basketball and baseball runs, run service days with local nonprofits, and raise money each year for a scholarship that helps North Carolina students head down to Gainesville.
story_paragraph_3: Membership is simple: show up. Dues help cover reserved space, game-day food and the scholarship fund, but you never need to pay a dollar to come watch a game with us.
